sentences.en: The restaurant stands at the junction of two superhighways.
sentences.zh: 这家餐馆位于两条高速公路的交叉路口。

sentences.en: More and more junctions are being built as roundabouts.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的环岛正在修建中。

sentences.en: The patient had back pain at the thoraco-lumbar junction.
sentences.zh: 患者的腰部在胸腰段交界处感到疼痛。

senses.zh: 连接点，交叉点；交汇处，汇合处；（电路的）连接，接合
